remarks:
Welcome to this charming home in a desirable North Jamestown neighborhood, conveniently located near Jamestown Community College with easy access to the highway. Offering a flexible layout and inviting living spaces, this home has plenty of room to accommodate a variety of needs.
At the back of the home, a spacious family room features built-in shelving, an electric fireplace, and a large window overlooking the private backyard and patio. A full bathroom and generously sized walk-in closet are conveniently located nearby. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining area, creating a comfortable space for everyday living and entertaining. At the front of the home, a second living room offers additional gathering space, complete with another electric fireplace, built-in shelving, and access to a side porch. A mature tree provides a touch of natural privacy, making the porch a lovely spot to relax.
Upstairs, you'll find four bedrooms with original hardwood floors and a second full bathroom with a tub/shower combination. The primary bedroom features two closets, while the fourth bedroom offers versatility as a home office, den, or guest room, with access to a walk-up finished attic that provides additional bonus space—ideal for a playroom, hobby area, or extra storage. Additional storage and a work bench can be found in the basement.
Outside, enjoy the private backyard and patio, along with the convenience of a one car garage and a storage shed. With two inviting living areas, four bedrooms, and flexible bonus space, this home offers comfort, functionality, and a convenient location.
